docs.title: Orbit desk lamp product sheet
docs.text: The Orbit desk lamp is an LED desk lamp with three brightness levels and a USB-C port in the base. List price: $49.00. Partner minimum order: 20 units. Warranty: two years from the date of sale.

docs.title: Partner shipping rules
docs.text: Partner orders of 100 units or more ship on a pallet at no charge. Smaller orders pay a flat $25 freight fee. Report damaged cartons within 7 days of delivery.
